reviews.title: Best motherboard upgrade.
reviews.comment: I recently purchased this motherboard in place of my current (MSI PRO B860) and let me tell you, it’s a fantastic upgrade. There are more features than my previous board, and you can fine tune just about aspect of bios. I even have the creation boost function enabled since this motherboard is capable of overlocking and is unlocked (unlike my previous). There is more than one USB-C port which nowadays is very handy. I haven’t had any issues whatsoever and its overall functionality is above expected to say the least. The build quality is also top notch. I ordered a board that was in used condition but it was perfectly fine, nothing wrong with it. It even comes with a heat sink for your SSD which is a nice bonus. I didn’t realize how much of a difference this board would make but i’m absolutely certain i made the right decision and would recommend to any power user out there looking for an upgrade.
reviews.author: Jonathan

reviews.title: Great motherboard. No need to spend $500
reviews.comment: This build went together super smooth and looks really clean. The MSI Mystic Lights controls the LEDs really well, but there needs to be more room for customization. The aren't a lot of options and some of them are redundant or boring. Very fast responding Z890 chipset and everything that goes along with it. The GOOD: Gorgeous motherboard (I actually ended up getting the White variant). Good rgb controls. Good layout. 4 PCIe x16 slots. USB 3.2 internal header for fast connections to your front or top panel USB C connections, as well as a USB 3.0 header and 2 USB 2.0 headers. Room for 3 NVME drives (one gen 5 and two gen 4 slots) as well as RAID connections for up to 4 hard drives. I'm really glad I got the white motherboard as it shows off the RGB so much better. All necessary mounting hardware and Wi-Fi antenna is included. The BAD: Only 1 NVME drive has the cool looking aluminum heatsink cover. The other two are bare. The UGLY: Don't buy a "used like new" or open box motherboard. The first one I got had the CPU pins destroyed, no socket cover, and NONE of the included accessories. I quickly returned it and ordered a new MB instead. Spend the extra few dollars. An open box CPU or RAM is probably safe but definitely not a motherboard unless there are pictures verifying the socket condition and all the accessories. The dang instruction sheet was even missing!

reviews.title: Awesome and Sleek looking mobo! Works great!
reviews.comment: Awesome mobo. Used 13 for a client. Looks nice. Lots of features. Lots of slots. BIOS looks cool and has a lot of features. Always have good luck with MSI boards and they always work great for me. The price I got them at was great for this board. WiFi zooms. No issues or bad boards in the lot so far!
